# AIVIA command line reference

This reference is generated from the registered command registry. Every registered subcommand is one section, listed in sorted order with its help text and the arguments its parser accepts. The committed copy is compared byte for byte, so a stale reference fails CI.

## Commands

| `add-language` | Add a language to an existing run, reusing its facts and visuals |
| `add_language` | Alias for add-language |

| `build` | Build stored assets such as pose libraries |
| `character` | Create and manage recurring characters |

| `order` | Create, show and delete personalized orders |
| `presets` | List named presets and show one as YAML |
| `profile` | Inspect content profiles and their derived settings |
| `prompts` | List prompt versions and select one per config or profile |
| `providers` | List provider types, run health checks and generate the reference |
| `publish` | Validate a publish target before posting. |
| `replay` | Replay a stored run from its snapshot and report artifact drift |
| `research` | Add hand-picked research topics with verification and dedupe |
| `resume` | Resume a budget-paused run after recording who confirmed and why |
| `retention` | Remove stale intermediates, cache, orders, deliveries, logs and hits |
| `review` | List, approve and reject reviews without a notifier |

| `session` | Manage an interactive editing session |
| `sfx` | Place sound effects on an existing timeline and print placements and cost |

## Global options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--character` | string | — | opt into a recurring character for this run |
| `--config` | string | — | config file to merge instead of the default location |
| `--dry-run` | boolean | — | preview the work without making paid calls or writing outputs |
| `--env`, `--environment` | string | — | merge config.<NAME>.yaml beside the user config |
| `--estimate` | boolean | — | print the cost estimate and exit without running anything |
| `--live` | boolean | — | allow calls to external services, subject to the live budget |
| `--no-cache` | boolean | — | ignore cached assets and generated responses |
| `--preset` | string | — | merge the overrides of a named preset after the profile |
| `--profile` | string | — | merge the overrides of a configured profile |
| `--set` | string | — | override a dotted key; repeatable and applied after the profile |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | boolean | — | print verbose diagnostic logging |
| `-y`, `--yes` | boolean | — | confirm consequential actions without prompting |

## `add-language`

Add a language to an existing run, reusing its facts and visuals

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--database`, `--db` | string | — | database file to update instead of the one in the user data directory |
| `--language`, `--languages` | string | — | language to add; repeatable or comma separated |
| `--run`, `--run-id` | string | — | existing run to extend with another language |

## `music`

Select a background music bed and print its source, license and ducking

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--attack-ms`, `--ducking-attack` | number | — | sidechain attack in milliseconds |
| `--commercial-only` | boolean | — | only select a track whose license allows commercial use |
| `--database`, `--db` | string | — | database file to read instead of the one in the user data directory |
| `--duck` | boolean | — | alias for --ducking |
| `--ducking`, `--no-ducking` | boolean | — | enable or disable voice ducking |
| `--duration`, `--duration-seconds` | number | — | requested bed duration |
| `--genre` | string | — | genre to match against the library or provider prompt |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | print the selection as JSON instead of text |
| `--library`, `--library-path` | string | — | music library manifest to select from |
| `--match-duration` | boolean | — | reject library tracks shorter than the requested duration |
| `--mood` | string | — | mood to match against the library or provider prompt |
| `--no-duck` | boolean | — | alias for --no-ducking |
| `--ratio`, `--ducking-ratio` | number | — | sidechain compression ratio |
| `--release-ms`, `--ducking-release` | number | — | sidechain release in milliseconds |
| `--run`, `--run-id` | string | — | existing run whose music stage to run |
| `--source` | string | — | where the bed may come from: auto, library or provider |
| `--tag`, `--tags` | string | — | style tag to match; repeatable or comma separated |
| `--tempo`, `--tempo-bpm` | number | — | preferred tempo in beats per minute |
| `--threshold-db`, `--ducking-threshold` | number | — | sidechain threshold where ducking starts |

## `run`

Run a format recipe; use --estimate to preview the cost

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--database`, `--db` | string | — | database file to use instead of the one in the user data directory |
| `--enqueue` | boolean | `false` | queue the run for a worker instead of executing it now |
| `--execute`, `--sync`, `--wait`, `--now` | boolean | `false` | execute the run immediately (the default) |
| `--format` | string | — | format recipe to run or estimate |
| `--idempotency-key`, `--idempotency` | string | — | return the existing run when KEY was already used for this request |
| `--reference`, `--ref` | string | — | reference image, video, audio or text to learn from; repeatable |
| `--script-file`, `--script` | string | — | use a prepared JSON, YAML or text script instead of writing |
| `--text-file`, `--text`, `--topic-file`, `--input-file` | string | — | read the topic from a text, JSON or YAML file instead of research |

## `sfx`

Place sound effects on an existing timeline and print placements and cost

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--database`, `--db` | string | — | database file to read instead of the one in the user data directory |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | print the placements as JSON instead of text |
| `--language`, `--languages` | string | — | language whose rules to place; repeatable or comma separated |
| `--placement`, `--position`, `--anchor` | string | — | default placement: start, center, end, word, offset or absolute |
| `--replace`, `--no-replace` | boolean | — | replace existing sfx tracks or keep and append to them |
| `--rules`, `--rule`, `--rule-file`, `--rule-files` | string | — | sfx rule file to load; repeatable or comma separated |
| `--run`, `--run-id` | string | — | existing run whose timeline receives the effects |
| `--timeline`, `--timeline-file` | string | — | timeline file to edit instead of timeline.json in the run directory |
| `--volume-db`, `--volume`, `--gain-db`, `--gain` | number | — | default gain for effects whose rule sets no volume |

## `worker`

Claim and run queued jobs until stopped

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--database`, `--db` | string | — | database file to use instead of the one in the user data directory |
